output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_invoice_payments
FROM marts.fct_payments p
JOIN marts.fct_orders o
  ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND p.method = 'invoice'
  AND (p.paid_at - o.order_date) > 30;
output.explanation: Joins payments to their orders, keeps orders placed in 2025 and payments with method 'invoice', and counts those where paid_at is more than 30 days after order_date. I assumed the method value is stored as lowercase 'invoice'; if the data uses a different casing or label, the filter would need adjusting. No revenue filter was applied because the question does not ask for one.
